blocks.title: Photovoltaic cell
blocks.text: Lafz photovoltaic photo (roshni) aur volt (bijli ka potential) se bana hai. Woh cell jo roshni ki energy ko bijli ki energy mein badalta hai photovoltaic cell kehlata hai.
Agle do topics photovoltaic (PV) cells ka usool aur paidar (sustainable) energy ke zariye ke taur par un ki khoobiyan dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Energy ke zariye mein photovoltaic cell galvanic cell se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Galvanic cell khud-ba-khud redox reaction ki kimiyai energy ko bijli ki energy mein badalta hai, to reactants kharch hone par khatam ho jata hai. Photovoltaic cell roshni ki energy ko seedha bijli ki energy mein badalta hai aur jab tak us par roshni pare kaam karta rehta hai, koi chemicals kharch kiye baghair.

items: Photovoltaic cell: roshni ki energy se bijli ki energy (photo = roshni, volt = potential).
